raw:
The team that won the 2013 Malaysian Grand Prix was Red Bull (Sebastian Vettel). In 2014, Red Bull won 3 races.

I checked the 2014 results round by round (19 races). Red Bull's wins were all by Daniel Ricciardo:
- Canadian Grand Prix (round 7)
- Hungarian Grand Prix (round 11)
- Belgian Grand Prix (round 12)

Vettel and Ricciardo finished on the podium in other races, but neither won any more.

ANSWER: 3
